replay.find: paramedics relocated the male to the B2 corridor
replay.note: The body was carried out of Cold Store 3 at 00:11, before anyone took a temperature.
So the 20.8 C ambient reading is the warm corridor, not the store he lay in.
The autopsy used that corridor reading. The arithmetic is right; the input is wrong, so its 19:41 time of death is wrong.
Cold Store 3 held 6 C all evening. At 6 C a body cools far more slowly: he died between about 21:45 and 22:25.
Renn saved a report at 21:51. He was alive and working, which fits the corrected window.
Two events on the oxygen-reduction system that night, and the extract does not say what they were.

replay.find: requires a Level-4 credential presented at that panel
replay.note: A manual discharge needs a Level-4 credential at the corridor panel. Only Marchetti and Pryce hold one.
Against the corrected window, Kovaleski had already left the vault level at 21:26.
Ferraro was on the ferry crossing all evening, far from the building.
21:58:41: the gas was discharged by hand at panel B2-P1 with the occupancy interlock overridden. This is how he died.
Pryce was at the Level D loading bay at 21:44 and 22:02, and the stairwell door never opened. He could not reach the panel.
Marchetti, supposedly at a dinner, came in through the Level D service door at 21:32 and left at 22:34.

replay.find: Last retained photograph including Ms Marchetti
replay.note: Her dinner alibi runs out at 20:20. It only ever covered the false time of death.
The motive: $412,000 from secretly selling four Halvorsen prints.
Her mistake: she took his tablet, but the report was already saved on the server.

debrief: How long did the file's own time of death go unquestioned at your table? That number is the case.
Was the moment it broke an 'aha' or a shrug?
Did the Authority limit ever hurt? If nobody agonised over a choice, the budget is too generous.
